_comment: Declared registry of strategy-104 config profiles that scheduled live / shadow / A-B paths actually load. The config-artifact-path gate (scripts/check_config_artifact_paths.py) validates EVERY profile listed here, not just the live config: a bad artifact path in a shadow / A-B profile matters because those profiles carry the ../../ PatchTST checkpoint as their PRIMARY scorer (the live config carries it as a shadow). Validating only strategy_config.json would miss the escape on the scheduled shadow / A-B load paths. Add a profile here whenever a new scheduled path can load one; codex CR on umbrella PR #525. Only add a profile once its file is confirmed to actually exist / be loaded somewhere in this repo -- a required entry for a file nothing produces makes this gate permanently fail closed (grepped-and-removed once already: xgb_prod_artifact_manifest.json, 2026-07-22).

_shapes.strategy_config: kernel strategy config: ranking.panel_scoring.{artifact_path, global_calibration.artifact_path, shadow_models[*].artifact_path} + panel_ltr.artifact_path
_shapes.artifact_manifest: operator artifact-manifest shape (production_primary.{artifact_path, global_calibration.artifact_path} + readonly_shadow.artifact_path) -- handler exists (collect_paths_artifact_manifest) and is unit-tested, but is NOT currently registered to any profile: no scheduled path in this repo loads a file in this shape today. Register a profile here only once a real file/loader exists.

profiles.loaded_by: readonly shadow path (PatchTST primary, XGB shadow)
